source.title: 2024 CB500F / CBR500R / NX500 Owner's Manual
source.custody: existing authenticated repository acquisition; no duplicate acquisition

observations.finding: The official 2024 owner manual title covers CB500F / CBR500R / NX500.

observations.locator: PDF p. 19 / printed p. 15, Anti-lock Brake System (ABS)
observations.finding: The manual states: This model is equipped with an Anti-lock Brake System (ABS).

observations.locator: PDF p. 180 / printed p. 179, Specifications / Service Data
observations.finding: The CBR500R is distinguished from NX500 in the same service-data table, and the recommended engine oil entry has no ABS qualifier.

observations.locator: PDF p. 180 / printed p. 179, Recommended engine oil
observations.finding: The preserved API/SAE/JASO/Honda-equivalent oil specification is presented in the common CB500F / CBR500R / NX500 Service Data section, with USA & Canada wording.

conclusion: Within the exact 2024 CBR500R PC70 USA/Canada manual scope, Honda documents the model as ABS-equipped; the oil specification is not restricted by an ABS qualifier. The bounded target is therefore ABS-known=true. This does not universalize the oil value to an undocumented non-ABS variant.
